title: The Female worker in the shop
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：female　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 female 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the shopkeeper wrote of ① a female worker in the shop in the account, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② so female that nobody in the shop would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the shopkeeper, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the female ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the female worker in the shop that anybody there had ever seen, or so the account for July 1966 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too female to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the female ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a female bird in the cage, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as female as the bird in the cage they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was female or not, and he said so.

By 1979 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was ⑦ something female, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite female; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the account kept the names of the female ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1982, twice over, she wrote of another female worker in the shop in the same account, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less female than anybody had expected. ⑩ The female bird in the cage that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1984, was the one she could never quite name; the female ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 女性（前置定语 a female worker in the shop：1972 年掌柜在账本里记下的那件女性的女工）
B. adj. 女性／雌（两处加强说法：so female that … 与 no less female than …）
C. adj. 女性／雌（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 女性（表语 too female to do：母亲觉得它太女性，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 雌（前置定语 a female bird in the cage：叔叔把整件事称作一桩雌的鸟）
F. adj. 雌（同级比较 as female as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩笼里的雌鸟相比）
G. adj. 雌（后置定语 something female：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 雌（受程度副词修饰 quite female：那位买主的评价）

items.q: a female worker in the shop
the female worker in the shop that
a female bird in the cage
The female bird in the cage that

answers.why: female 意为“女性”，1972 年掌柜在账本里记下的是“一件女性的女工”，此处作前置定语 a female worker in the shop。
female 意为“女性”，此处用 so female that 结构，说它女性到铺子里没人敢靠近。
female 意为“女性”，账本上 七月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的女性店里的女工，等于最高级的说法。
female 意为“女性”，母亲认为这件东西“太女性了，谁也用不上”，too female to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
female 意为“雌”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩雌的鸟”，此处作前置定语 a female bird in the cage。
female 意为“雌”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩笼里的雌鸟一样雌”，同级比较用 as female as。
female 意为“雌”，账本上那半行字要的是“雌的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something female。
female 意为“雌”，邻铺子来的那位买主认为这套计划“相当雌”，quite 修饰原级 female。
female 意为“雌”，no less female than 表示“其雌不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之雌不亚于任何人的预料。
female 意为“雌”，母亲 1984 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的雌鸟”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1972 年，掌柜在账本里记下了一件女性的女工。（a female worker in the shop）
它女性到铺子里没有一个人敢靠近。（so female that …）
母亲觉得它太女性，谁也用不上。（too female to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩雌的鸟。（a female bird in the cage）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩笼里的雌鸟一样雌。（as female as …）
到了 1979 年，账本上只剩半行字：要的是一件雌的东西。（something female）
answers: In 1972 the shopkeeper wrote of a female worker in the shop in the account.
It was so female that nobody in the shop would go near it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 female 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the shopkeeper wrote of a female worker in the shop in the account, and nobody forgot it.
It was the female worker in the shop that anybody there had ever seen, or so the account says.
My mother thought it too female to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a female bird in the cage, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next shop called the plan quite female, and everybody laughed.
The female ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
